releases.name: AnyPS5-ARM 0.2.41
releases.body:
AnyPS5-ARM 0.2.41 brings **PS1 games into the Mac launcher's own window**, through the signed PS1 emulator host that **Settings › Emulators can now download** (anyps5-retro-host 1.1.0 with SwanStation, by B-Howell), with **save states**, an **Internal resolution** choice and the **PS menu** that AnyPS5 Desktop has (B-Howell's Desktop work, ported to the Mac). **A game now starts from its cover** (designed by Lenny4250gh for AnyPS5 Desktop), and **quitting the launcher while a game plays closes the game first** and gives it time to save. **AnyPS5 Desktop 0.1.27** brings save states and Internal resolution to PS1 games on Windows and Linux. The engine has not changed since 0.2.40, and the phone app stays **AnyPS5 Remote 1.23**. Like every release, it is **signed**.

## Mac launcher

- **Settings › Emulators can download the PS1 emulator.** With emulator games turned on, a new row downloads the AnyPS5 emulator host with SwanStation from its signed releases (now anyps5-retro-host 1.1.0). Nothing is downloaded until you select it. The download's signature and every file are checked before it is installed, and again before every game. Select the row later to look for an update.

releases.name: ARMSX3 1.7.1
releases.body: # ARMSX3 1.7.1 ## Games - **Uncharted 2: Among Thieves, Super Street Fighter IV, Journey, and other games:** fixed the stop with "Failed to compile fragment shader" at the default Shader Precision (Low). - **Ratchet & Clank: Tools of Destruction:** fixed the freeze on Cobalia (thanks Seeslo for testing). -**Uncharted 3: Drake’s Deception** gets The Last of Us fix for freezes during play, since both games run the same job system, prevents freezes in UC3. ## Save states - **Save states from 1.7 and earlier don't load in 1.7.1,** because RPCS3's font module update changed the save state format. In-game saves are not affected.

releases.name: ARMSX3 1.7
releases.body: # ARMSX3 1.7 ## Highlights - **New SPU code compiles in the background.** Games keep running while it compiles, so new areas load without pausing. Games that need the old pause keep it. - **Compiled SPU code now carries over between updates,** including game updates, so first boots after them are quick. Each game compiles once more on its first boot after this update. ## The Last of Us - **Fixed the freeze during play.** The game hands its work to background jobs and waits for them, and on phones a job list could stop with work still in it, freezing the game anywhere from minutes to hours in. ARMSX3 now keeps those jobs moving.

releases.name: ARMSX3 for iOS 0.0.3 beta
releases.body:
## XMB mode

**The PS3's own menu.** ARMSX3 can now look and work like the PS3's XMB: the wave and sparkles, the boot, every column with its rows and settings, music with the Waves, Valley and Gaia visualizers, a video player, a photo viewer with slideshows, the XMB keyboard, and the in-game XMB with save states, Change Disc and Turn Off System. The icons, words, font and sounds come from your installed firmware, and a PS3 theme brings its own. Turn it on with the wave button in the library bar or in the last step of setup. On an iPhone it holds the screen in landscape, and while a game runs it lets go of its wave to leave the game more memory.

**Built-in Track and Turned off.** The Music column plays a built-in track, and Diagnostics lists a session you ended with Turn Off System as Turned off, where it said Closed by iOS.

## Black Ops III

releases.name: ARMSX3 for iOS 0.0.2 beta
releases.body:
Changes since 0.0.1. Thanks to everyone who sent problem reports, since most of these fixes came from them. This is a beta: the JIT changes ran on an iPhone, and everything else was tested on a Mac. Please send a report if something works worse than in 0.0.1.

## Requirements and install

ARMSX3 for iOS needs an iPhone or iPad with an A14 chip or newer, on iOS 17.4 or later. It isn't on the App Store, so install the IPA with SideStore, AltStore or LiveContainer. JIT needs a pairing file for your device (see Pairing files below).

## Update LiveContainer first

If you run ARMSX3 inside LiveContainer, update LiveContainer to 3.8.13 or later before you install this build. That is the nightly build at the moment: https://github.com/LiveContainer/LiveContainer/releases/tag/nightly Older versions can't load the JIT helper, and ARMSX3 will fall back to StikDebug.

In LiveContainer, turn on Helper Process Support for ARMSX3, and open ARMSX3 full screen, not in a window.

⚠️⚠️⚠️
This version fixes a critical security vulnerability that was publicly announced so immediate update is advised
https://github.com/azahar-emu/azahar/security/advisories/GHSA-h74v-5mw8-qg8r
⚠️⚠️⚠️

AzaharPlus 2126.2-A is the same as Azahar 2126.2 except for this:

- Compatibility with all game files. If a file works with any Citra fork, it works with AzaharPlus.
- Ability to download system files from official servers. No need for an actual 3DS.
- Compatibility with older CPUs (no SSE4.2 required)
- Compatibility with Android 9
- ZipPass: A new way to exchange StreetPass data through zip files
- Built in cheats
- Amiibo generation
- Better multiplayer compatibility with other Citra forks

The Android build is available in 2 flavors.

- Replace: It has the same application id as Azahar, so it will replace it on the device.
Its display name is "AzaharPlus" and its icon background is blue.
Use this one if you have other apps that target Azahar, like a frontend for example.

releases.body:
You need **Xbox360 Call of Duty 3 (USA, Europe).iso** file for install!

> **Still in development: bugs can and will occur.**
> *Még fejlesztés alatt: hibák előfordulhatnak.*

The first release since [0.4.0](https://github.com/FrankHUN88453/CoD3Recomp/releases/tag/v0.4.0): one executable that keeps itself up to date, the game's own menus played with the mouse, prompts that name your keys, and a faster renderer.

## New

- **One file: `CoD3SP_s.exe`.** FFmpeg's libraries for the sound and the films are built into it; nothing else to unpack.
- **Updates itself.** At every start it asks GitHub for a newer release; if there is one, it downloads it, replaces itself and starts the new version. Turn it off with `auto_update = 0` under `[game]` in `CoD3Recomp.ini`, or start it with `--no-update`.

releases.name: Call of Duty 3 - PC Port - 0.4.0
releases.body:
You need **Xbox360 Call of Duty 3 (USA, Europe).iso** file for install!

> **Still in development: bugs can and will occur.**
> *Még fejlesztés alatt: hibák előfordulhatnak.*

The first release since [0.3.0](https://github.com/FrankHUN88453/CoD3Recomp/releases/tag/v0.3.0): a faster game, a picture closer to the console's, and two experimental options that make it faster still.

## New

- **Faster on every level.** The emulated kernel woke every waiting thread whenever anything was signalled (one of the game's locks is released some 50,000 times a second); now only the threads waiting for that object wake. The game's CPU use dropped from about 5.4 cores to 3.3, and the forest at 1080p without MSAA went from about 91 to 95–108 frames a second.
- **Native command lists (experimental)**, in the F11 menu, after a restart. The draws are made from the game's own Direct3D calls, and the console's GPU command stream is run only for what the GPU still has to do. With **Watch memory writes (experimental)** also on, the forest at 1080p without MSAA runs at about 180 frames a second. Tested on eight levels, the films and mission restarts; off by default until it has been played more.

releases.body:

## New

- **The next mission after a win.** The console restarts the game between missions and hands the next one over; the port does the same, so a finished mission leads into the next one instead of closing the game.
- **A mission's briefing film can be skipped** with Space (A) once its level has loaded. On the console it always plays to its end.

releases.name: Call of Duty 3 - PC Port - 0.2.3
releases.body:
You need **Xbox360 Call of Duty 3 (USA, Europe).iso** file for install!

A fix release over [0.2.2](https://github.com/FrankHUN88453/CoD3Recomp/releases/tag/v0.2.2), and the one worth updating for: the lighting is right now.

## Fixed

**Walls lit far too brightly, and the odd shading on the soldiers and on the player's hands.** An instruction of the console's shaders has a vector half and a scalar half, and they run together: both read the registers as they were before the instruction and only then write. The translation wrote the vector's result first, so a scalar that read the very register the vector wrote got the new value instead of the old one.

The game's third light per surface is written exactly that way. Its scalar wants the specular exponent times a logarithm; with the write first it took a dot product instead, and two to the tenth of that became the specular. Every lit stone wall in Mayenne came out white with pink and green speckle, and characters were shaded oddly for the same reason. Eighty of the six hundred shader programs a level draws with have such an instruction, so this shows up all over the game, not only on that wall.

## Known issues

releases.name: Call of Duty 3 - PC Port - 0.2.2
releases.body:
You need **Xbox360 Call of Duty 3 (USA, Europe).iso** file for install!

A fix release over [0.2.1](https://github.com/FrankHUN88453/CoD3Recomp/releases/tag/v0.2.1); everything below is on top of what 0.2.1 brought.

## Fixed

**The HUD and the menu still flickered.** 0.2.1 looked at every texture every frame again, but a large one that had been still for a while was only *sampled*: sixty four places out of it. The HUD's fonts, icons and compass are small and change a handful of texels at a time, and the samples missed those changes, so the old picture stayed up for a frame. Everything up to two megabytes is now hashed whole, every frame, and only what is bigger than that falls back to sampling.

**Shadow filtering collapsed.** A texture fetch on the console carries three signed offsets in halves of a texel. The game's shadows are one map fetched four times at the corners of a texel; with the offsets dropped those were four fetches of the same texel, so a surface came out wholly lit or wholly dark instead of softly edged.

# 0.60.1 is out

There was a bug in the AppImage Updater Code. To fix this i have to revert to the old AppImage build and wait several weeks to ensure a smooth update process.

# 0.60.0 is out 🎉

This release is special for me. I build emuze with web technologies because that’s where I have the most experience, and I’m really proud of what I’ve achieved over the years. I’ve always wanted to help out in this wonderful emulation community, but aside from testing, I couldn’t do much to help with the emulators I love because I struggled with C++ code, which most emulators are written in. But sometimes you feel forced to try and try again. Since v0.59.0, I’ve successfully added a [change to RMG](https://github.com/Rosalie241/RMG/pull/518) to use the SDL GUID to identify a gamepad more reliably, and I forked Mednafen with [mednafen-sdl3](https://github.com/bmsuseluda/mednafen-sdl3) to greatly expand gamepad support. Those changes are just baby steps in the grand scheme of things, but they felt great, and I hope I can build on them in the future.

# 0.59.2 is out 🎉

This release is mostly preparation work to greatly reduce the file size of the AppImage with release 0.60.0.
Besides this fuse2 is not necessary anymore and Metainfos for AppImage Managers e.g. AM are included.

Please let me know what you think of it in the [emuze discord](https://discord.gg/tCzK7kc6Y4).

## 💥 Features
- added AppImage Metainfos
- AppImage works without fuse2
- Preparation work to greatly reduce the file size of the AppImage with release 0.60.0

# 0.59.0 is out 🎉

As you might now i love the simplicity of console gaming. You start the game and it just works. With emulation more often then not you have to provide more then just the game. You need things like a BIOS file, firmware or key files. I wanted to assist with this for a long time. With this release you can choose a folder where you can put your BIOS files and emuze will pick them up and configure the Emulators. Of course emuze will tell you if a required file is missing. On top of this emuze comes bundled with open source BIOS implementations for PlayStation, Game Boy Advance and NEO GEO. Of course you can use official BIOS files instead if you need by putting them in the BIOS folder. Sadly i was not able to achieve the same result for more complicated systems like PlayStation 3, WiiU and Switch. These systems require a installation of a firmware. I will try to tackle these in a future release.

Besides this i bundled and pre configured ScummVM and DOSBox Pure Unleashed.
Therefore the day is finally here: All 35 supported systems are pre configured and bundled now 🥳

# 0.58.0 is out 🎉

As one of the few nerdy kids in a small sleepy town in a country where arcade gaming was classified as gambling i could see lightgun games in magazines only. I had an NES and Captain N with his Zapper was sooo awesome to me. But when the time came that i could buy one with my own money the rise of flat panels began and with it the death of CRT TVs and Lightguns altogether. It was just a thing of the past, sadly.
But surprisingly the genre came back with the Wii and PS3 and there Pointer devices. Some years later camera based Lightguns came to the market and finally Lightgun gaming with the same and even higher precision is possible on flat panels.

## What's new

- **A new name.** CHD Manager is now Game Format Converter, because it converts far more than CHDs. It lives at a new repository address with new file names. **If you have an older CHD Manager, download this release once by hand: the old program can't find it by itself.** Your settings and keys don't carry over; put them in again under Settings for the optional features that use them.
- **Xbox 360:** ZAR (for Xenia), ISO and game folders. Hex-named download packages (Xbox Live Arcade, Games on Demand) aren't discs, so they are refused with an explanation.
- **Original Xbox:** a full dump becomes a trimmed `.xiso.iso` (7.8 GB down to just the game); also game folders and CHD.
- **PlayStation 3:** game folder to ISO and back, split pieces joined, `.pkg` packages unpacked and packed (with your own RPCS3 or your own key).
- **Nintendo Switch:** NSP to XCI and back, bundles with the newest update and DLC, one NSP per title, swapping in a newer update. **Switch 2:** folder to NUP and back (experimental).

releases.name: WWE '12 PC 1.5.0 "Small PCs"
releases.body:
# WWE '12 PC 1.5.0 "Small PCs"

This version is about PCs with few or slow CPU cores: a start-up freeze is fixed, parts of the game run faster, and there is a new FPS counter. It also fixes two Universe problems.

## Fixes

- **Fixed a rare freeze on "NOW LOADING" at start-up** on PCs with few or slow CPU cores (a race between the game's sound-bank loading threads). The game could stay on the first loading screen forever. On a test PC limited to 2 slow cores it froze in 2 starts out of 10 before the fix and never in 10 starts after it (#69, #74: if your freeze has another cause, tell us). 
- **No more loading-screen speed-up on PCs with fewer than 8 usable threads**, where it could lock the game at its frame barrier.
- **Universe: SmackDown (and other weekly shows) no longer end up with only 0-1 match** when their roster is small: a match that would be dropped because everyone is resting now takes a rested Superstar instead.

# WWE '12 PC 1.4.1

A small update after 1.4.0: a Royal Rumble crash fixed, and belt modding in the Mod Maker.

## Fixes

- **Royal Rumble crash (#79):** in 1.4.0, the animations added for the I QUIT match were loaded in **every** match. The Royal Rumble, which loads the most wrestlers, could run out of room in the game's animation memory and crash, or leave wrestlers frozen and entrants stuck behind the ramp. They are now only added in an **I QUIT** match or a **Special Guest Referee** match; every other match is the original game again. I QUIT and the special referee work as before.

## Mod Maker

- **Belt modding.** In BELTS & WEAPONS, a new **Port a belt from another game** page: bring a title belt from WWE 2K14, 2K15, WWE '13, 2K16 / 2K17 or SvR 2007-2011 in place of one of the game's belts, with its menu pictures (belt, background, statistics, unlock icons). releases.name: v1.3.0
releases.body:
**WWE '12 PC v1.3.0 — "Speed and fixes"**

> ⚠️ No game data included: you need your own copy of WWE '12 for Xbox 360.

### Faster
- **Loading screens shorter** (a match loads in about 1.5 s instead of 4 s, the end of the entrances in about 1.9 s instead of 4.5 s). `wwe12_fast_loading = false` brings the old behaviour back.
- **Faster start-up** on PCs with 8 or more logical processors: the title screen comes after about 5-7 s instead of 15 s. On smaller processors the normal start-up is kept (`wwe12_fast_boot_min_threads`).
- **Sharper picture** when the game is drawn at 720p on a bigger screen (`svr_upscale_sharpness`, 0 turns it off).
- **Adaptive V-sync**: a late frame is shown at once instead of waiting a whole refresh (`svr_adaptive_vsync`).
- **Performance test** in the launcher (button *Performance test*): it plays a recorded 1-on-1 match with entrances once and tells you if your PC is fine, limited by the processor or by the graphics card. Nothing is changed without your agreement.

### Frame rate

**WWE '12 PC v1.2.0 — "Moveset update"**

> ⚠️ No game data included: you need your own copy of WWE '12 for Xbox 360.

### Fixed
- **Match-start stutter (and a short freeze) on integrated graphics (Intel...)**: the game's reads of the picture back from the graphics card are now grouped at the end of the frame (about 10 times less waiting at the start of a match). `svr_readback_defer_streak = false` goes back to 1.1.
- **Less work for the processor every frame** (helps small PCs, issue #53): shader constants are reused like on Android (`svr_reuse_constant_blocks`) and the check of 3D models is lighter (`svr_geometry_sample_min`, 32768 brings the 1.1 behaviour back).
- **Crash at start with file names that have accents or other characters** (for example a song called "Café.mp3" or a mod folder with Japanese letters in a mod): names are now read as UTF-8 everywhere in the game, the launcher and the Mod Maker, and a mod with an unreadable name is skipped instead of closing the game.
- **Launcher: the MUSIC page closed the launcher** when a file in the `music` folder had an odd name.

releases.body:
# 说明
此版本为热修复版本，你可以选择覆盖原有apk或者删除原apk重新安装。

- Wine：加入Proton-Wine，你可以在附加内容中进行下载安装

# Bug修复
- MangoHud：优化骁龙GPU监控性能，修复Adreno卡顿和N/A跳变

- 由于Termux-X11的渲染问题，在容器中使用"创建快捷方式"功能的时候会触发渲染错误，退出容器后重新启动即可解决，此问题并不影响快捷方式的创建
- 由于a8xx架构处理器将路径锁死，用户态没有权限读取GPU的实时数据，所以a8xx设备在使用MangoHud和安卓层面的性能监控的时候GPU占用会显示N/A，大部分a7xx设备都可以正常读取GPU占用率，因为我没有a6xx所以无法获取测试数据

releases.name: Winlator-Glibc v2.0
releases.body:
# 说明
从Winlator-Glibc v2版本开始项目将使用全新命名空间，这意味着你可以无需删除曾经的v1或者7.1.6版本即可安装此版本，但是我依然推荐你将曾经的版本删除，以后我将只为拥有新命名空间的版本进行软件包的更新与维护，新旧版本的 Wine、Box64、Turnip 等组件不再兼容，也无法混用。
# 更新内容
- 使用全新安卓命名空间
- 重新编译rootfs
- 支持 Vulkan 1.4+ API
- 弃用X Server服务，使用Termux-X11作为显示后端（来自[ewt45](https://github.com/[ewt45](https://github.com/ewt45))）
- 升级Zink版本，Zink版本将与Turnip版本同步更新
- 添加Freedreno驱动支持
- 补全GStreamer环境，当前版本：稳定版 v1.28.3（来自[Waim908](https://github.com/Waim908)）
- 升级MangoHud版本，当前版本：正式版 v0.8.4
- 优化安卓层面的性能监控，GPU采用获取真实数据逻辑
- 添加KDE桌面鼠标主题，可在编辑容器界面中的Wine配置选项中切换主题与鼠标大小
# Bug修复
- 修复启动容器与退出容器有几率崩溃的问题（来自[ewt45](https://github.com/[ewt45](https://github.com/ewt45))）
- 修复摇杆无法自由移动的问题
- 修复快捷方式中"添加到主屏幕"功能不可用的问题
- 修复虚拟控件手柄摇杆有几率卡住的问题
- 修复使用桌面快捷方式启动容器应用时无法启动的问题
# 常见问题说明
- 由于Termux-X11的渲染问题，在容器中使用"创建快捷方式"功能的时候会触发渲染错误，退出容器后重新启动即可解决，此问题并不影响快捷方式的创建
- 由于a8xx架构处理器将路径锁死，用户态没有权限读取GPU的实时数据，所以a8xx设备在使用MangoHud和安卓层面的性能监控的时候GPU占用会显示N/A，大部分a7xx设备都可以正常读取GPU占用率，因为我没有a6xx所以无法获取测试数据
- 在使用虚拟控件的过程中如果发现视角被限制无法移动，请在触控设置中打开"相对光标移动"选项

releases.name: Winlator-Glibc v1.0-RC1
releases.body:
# 说明

此发布包为 RC1 版本，作为 Winlator-Glibc 项目的第一个测试版。本项目基于[原 7.1.5-glibc 版本](https://github.com/longjunyu2/winlator)更新而来，我们决定将 glibc 版本独立出来作为新项目开发，因此软件已更名并重置版本号。

---

> **提示**：如果你之前已安装我们的 7.1.6-beta1 测试版本，建议替换为本发布页面的 v1-RC1 版本。7.1.6-beta1 将不再维护，我们不再使用 7.1.x 命名版本号，今后将基于 v1 版本长期更新与维护。

# 更新内容
- 添加Arm64ec架构的wine（10.14）
- 添加FEX-PE模拟
- 更新Box64-0.4.1和Box64-0.38
- 更新Turnip-26.1.0
- 更新DXVK-2.7.1
- 加入终端支持
- Gstreamer更新至1.28.1
- 加入Termux-x11的显示后端支持

- 由于Winlator-Glibc的结构特殊性，目前仍无法实现与Winlator原版的共存
- 在原生x server的显示模式中部分wine会出现虚拟控件无法使用的情况，解决办法是去到设置界面启用Termux-x11的显示模式
- 使用Termux-x11显示模式时如果遇到视角卡死受限的情况请在操控选项中启用相对光标移动
- 编辑容器中的"显示FPS"功能所展示的GPU占用性能数据是不准确的，仅供娱乐使用，由于我们无法找到在设备未root的情况下能正常读取GPU数据的办法，所以此项功能仅仅只是基于已有数据推测，如果你需要准确的性能占用情况，请在容器中使用DXVK_HUD的变量开启性能监控
- Gstreamer在对部分游戏解码的时候仍存在问题，请等待正式版修复
- Turnip-26.1.0驱动对于Snapdragon 8 Elite以上处理器的支持仍不完整，目前仅供测试使用

releases.name: hakuX 1.3.0
releases.body:
Xbox Live through Insignia, and game fixes.

### Xbox Live
- **Insignia** — Settings → Network → Connection → Xbox Live: Insignia connects the console to Insignia, the revival of the original Xbox Live: Live games sign in, find matches and play online. If your Internet provider blocks Insignia's DNS server, point it at a computer running insigniaDNS instead
- **Xbox Live setup** — Settings → Network → Xbox Live setup walks you through it, one step at a time: the connection, the Xbox dashboard, registering the console with Insignia's Setup Assistant (downloaded for you), then making or recovering your account in the dashboard
- **Dashboard** — the library's Dashboard button (top left) starts the Xbox dashboard from the console's hard disk, where Xbox Live accounts are made and recovered. The first time, it installs the dashboard from a zip of its files (dashboard 5960) that you provide: hakuX doesn't include one
- **Title updates** — a game's Xbox Live update, once downloaded, starts with the game. Forza Motorsport's 60 and 120 fps mods cover its update too

### Games
- **Fable: The Lost Chapters** — the hero's face and arms are no longer black or noise

releases.name: hakuX 1.2.0
releases.body:
System link, stability and compatibility improvements.

### Network
- **System link over your network** — Settings → Network → System link → LAN: hakuX devices on the same Wi-Fi network find each other as Xbox consoles on a LAN do. Devices the network's broadcasts don't reach, on another subnet or a VPN such as ZeroTier or Tailscale, are added by address under Other consoles
- **XLink Kai** — system link over the Internet through an XLink Kai engine running on a computer on your network; its web page picks the game's arena
- **Console identity** — each console has its own serial number, network address and online key. A device whose hard disk was copied from another one offers to make itself a new identity, since two consoles with one identity can't see each other


### Games
- **Sega GT 2002** — the cars have their paint, reflections and sun highlights
- **Doom 3** — no longer crashes as its main menu loads
- **Fatal Frame II** — starts and reads its disc in the order it asks for
- **AirForce Delta Storm** — answers the controller and the on-screen controls (it ignored all input)
- **Silent Hill 2** — no longer crashes when it loads a room

releases.name: hakuX 1.1.0
releases.body:
GPUs beyond Adreno (experimental).

### GPUs
- **Mali, Xclipse and PowerVR (experimental)** — hakuX runs on GPUs other than Adreno: features they lack are replaced (BC and 4444 textures decoded up front, standard border colours, the push block in a buffer, D32S8 depth), and known driver bugs are worked around (`hw/xbox/hle/vk/quirks.c`). Burnout 3 and Mercenaries run cleanly on a Pixel 8 (Mali-G715)
- **Vulkan 1.1 drivers** — GPUs whose drivers stop at Vulkan 1.1 (Valhall Mali on older or vendor-capped drivers, Qualcomm's own older drivers, early Xclipse, PowerVR BXM) run through a compatibility layer (`hw/xbox/hle/vk/compat.c`)
- **Older GPUs without descriptor indexing (experimental)** — Bifrost Mali (G71, G72, G76, G52) and PowerVR Rogue: each draw binds its own textures, and depth is clamped in the shader where the GPU can't
- **Adreno** — unchanged: every replacement is off where the GPU has the feature.

### App
- **GPU driver** — a screen of its own (Settings → GPU driver): the system driver and the stored packages in one list, with their versions and authors. Packages are checked when added and can be deleted (deleting the one in use goes back to the system driver)

releases.name: hakuX 1.0.0
releases.body:
A new core replaces xemu's QEMU-based one.

### New core
- **CPU** — the Xbox's x86 code runs on a FEX JIT (FEXCore fork), and the Xbox kernel is reimplemented natively (`native/kernel`): no QEMU
- **GPU** — the NV2A push buffer is decoded into Vulkan (HLE, `hw/xbox/hle`). Custom drivers (Turnip) load through adrenotools; driver-specific workarounds are quirks (`hw/xbox/hle/vk/quirks.c`, `debug.hakux.quirks`)
- **Audio** — the MCPX APU runs on the core's own services (`native/dev/apu`), out through AAudio
- **Savestates** — per game, in slots, with the hard disk's files
- **Mods and cheats** — per game, from `mods/` (library long-press "Mods & cheats"): XBE patches and replaced disc files; 60 and 120 fps mods for 13 games (`mods/README.md`, generators in `tools/mods`)
- **Controllers** — each physical controller routed to a player with its own mapping; the on-screen controller adds to player 1

### New features
- **Updates** — hakuX looks for a newer release on GitHub when it starts and on demand (Settings → Updates); one found shows its notes and installs from there
- **Frontends** — a game launched from ES-DE or another frontend returns to it when it closes

releases.body:
# SeedlessDS 1.1 正式版

版本名为 `1.1`，版本号为 `153`。本次同时发布原包名替换版、共存版、对应源码及 SHA-256 校验文件。两版均关闭 Android 调试标志，正式版本号与发布文件名均不含 debug，测试控制面板关闭。

## 本次改进

- 修复后台存档提前完成时，完成状态被模拟线程覆盖，导致后续快速存档和读档一直被忽略的问题。
- 减少存读档结束后的多余槽位查询、成就附加档读取和目录扫描，成就校验改为流式 SHA-256。
- 拆分即时存档、游戏电池存档和其它文件的访问锁，避免后台慢存档连带阻塞游戏文件读取。后台存档线程降低优先级。
- 防止并发慢查询重新发布已失效的目录列表，修复日志时间格式化的并发访问。
- 在应用私有目录保留有大小上限的近期存读档记录，便于追查偶发卡顿。
- 保留 SoundTouch 原声音高加速、低延迟音频恢复修复，以及按 RP Duo 上下屏实际画面尺寸适配的柔和颗粒、柔和颗粒＋和 Nova 磷光点滤镜。

## 安装包选择

| 文件 | Android 包名 | 安装方式 |
|---|---|---|
| `seedless-ds-1.1-coexist.apk` | `com.seedlessds.app.debug` | 可直接更新本分支旧共存版，也可与官方版共存 |
| `seedless-ds-1.1-replacement.apk` | `com.seedlessds.app` | 原包名替换版 |
| `seedless-ds-fork-1.1-src.zip` | — | 两版对应的完整源码与构建配置 |
| `seedless-ds-1.1-SHA256.txt` | — | 安装包和源码校验值 |

共存版按用户选择保留历史包名中的 `.debug`，以支持覆盖更新，应用本身已关闭调试。两版均沿用本分支旧签名。

替换版与官方版签名不同。首次换用替换版，请先导出存档与配置，再卸载官方版并安装。直接覆盖官方版会因签名不匹配而失败。两个包名的数据各自独立，切换使用时需导入存档。

两版均支持 ARM64，最低 Android 5.0。证书 SHA-256 为 `99e2395bd7c458a577e6bc4f4c7237a7474cb20a178fad07313c2778a7943165`，沿用仓库随源公开测试签名。

## 验证范围

- 两种正式构建各 128 项应用测试通过，完成构建、Lint、包名和签名检查，并核对 `debuggable=false`、`testOnly=false` 及 `BuildConfig.DEBUG=false`。两版的应用资源和原生库一致。
- 原生回归覆盖 21 类存档故障、280 轮重复存读档及请求交错。

# Swap2-Native 0.1.9.3-beta

Swap2-Native now speaks the Switch 2's 16 languages, works with a controller from the library to the in-game panel, has a redesigned in-game panel, and offers a frame rate cap in every game.

**Install over 0.1.9.1-beta (or any 0.1.5-beta and later).** Games, packs, mods and saves are kept. The shaders do not change.

## New

- **The app in 16 languages.** Every menu, dialog and the in-game panel follow your phone's language: English (US and UK), Japanese, French (France and Canada), German, Italian, Spanish (Spain and Latin America), Dutch, Portuguese (Brazil and Portugal), Russian, Korean and Chinese (Simplified and Traditional). To use another one, pick it in **Settings › Interface › App language** (or in Android's own app language setting).
- **Controller navigation.** In the library, with a game selected: **A** plays it, **Y** opens its Game settings, **L / R** switch tabs. Buttons follow the Nintendo layout (A right, B bottom) by default; **Settings › Interface** keeps the Xbox layout if you prefer it.

Zelda: Ocarina of Time can run at 30 fps in its heaviest scenes, and every game can be played in your language.

Turned off, the game's mesh-drawn geometry is not drawn: in Zelda that is much of the foliage, the falling leaves and some objects. ## Faster

# Swap2-Native 0.1.8.9-beta

The frame rate cap of Zelda: Ocarina of Time can be chosen again, so the game keeps real time.

**Install over 0.1.8.8-beta (or any 0.1.5-beta and later).** Games, packs, mods and saves are kept. The shaders do not change.

## Fixed

- **Zelda's frame rate cap was greyed out.** Its Game settings and the in-game panel said the game picks its own frame rate and offered no cap. A Zelda left at "The game's own" then moved forward 1/30 of a second each frame, so below 30 fps it ran in slow motion (about 0.7 of real time at 21 fps on our POCO F7 Ultra).
  - The cap now offers **30 fps** and **60 fps** for Zelda again, in its Game settings and in the in-game panel. Pick 30 fps (the default) to keep real time; 0.1.8.8-beta's fix makes it hold down to 20 fps.
  - Switching back to "The game's own" while the game runs now takes effect at once.
- If Zelda still runs slowly after updating, open Zelda once: the app then sees the new cap choices. Then set **Frame rate cap** to **30 fps** or **Default** in Zelda's Game settings.

## If your game stops

releases.name: Swap2-Native 0.1.8.8-beta
releases.body:
# Swap2-Native 0.1.8.8-beta

Zelda: Ocarina of Time no longer runs in slow motion where the phone cannot hold 30 fps.

**Install over 0.1.8.7-beta (or any 0.1.5-beta and later).** Games, packs, mods and saves are kept. The shaders do not change: if you already updated them for 0.1.8.7-beta, nothing is translated again.

## Fixed

- **Slow motion below 30 fps with the 30 fps cap.** Where the phone drew fewer than 30 frames a second, each frame still moved the game forward by only 1/30 of a second, so the game ran slower than real time. It now moves the game forward by 1/20 of a second there, and the game keeps real time.
  - On our test phone (POCO F7 Ultra), Kokiri Forest by the scarecrow: before, about 22 fps at three quarters of real time; now a steady 20 fps at real time, with fewer stutters. By Mido: 30 fps, as before.
  - The 60 fps setting and the uncapped setting are unchanged.

## Tips

- **Frame generation** (Settings › Performance, with your own Lossless.dll) works well with the 30 fps cap on the POCO F7 Ultra: it costs about half a frame a second by the scarecrow and shows twice the frames on screen.

## If your game stops

releases.name: Swap2-Native 0.1.8.7-beta
releases.body:
# Swap2-Native 0.1.8.7-beta

Zelda: Ocarina of Time runs faster where there is a lot of grass and foliage, and the app uses less memory in a few places.

**Install over 0.1.8.6-beta (or any 0.1.5-beta and later).** Games, packs, mods and saves are kept.

**Zelda's shaders are updated once after installing.** Only the 500 shaders of grass and foliage change. The app starts the update by itself when you open Zelda and does it in the background: about 30 minutes on our POCO F7 Ultra (most of it reading the game's shaders again). You can play during the update with the old shaders; the gain below comes once it finishes. Keep the phone charging.

## Faster

- **Grass and foliage in Zelda: Ocarina of Time.** The game draws them with mesh shaders, which phones run through compute. Those computes kept every output in a slow on-chip copy, and the GPU could keep only a few of them busy at once. They now write their outputs straight to memory.
  - On our test phone (POCO F7 Ultra), Kokiri Forest by the scarecrow: about 18.6 fps before, 22.8 now. By Mido: 34 fps before, 41.9 now. The picture is the same.

releases.name: v0.1.0
releases.body:
The first release of Odin.

Odin (ᚨ) is a low-level emulator of the SEGA Hikaru arcade board. It runs the programs of the real chips wherever they are known, and draws with OpenGL or Vulkan. It is a hard fork of Valkyrie, by Stefano Teso.

## Games

All six Hikaru games, two of them in two versions:

- Air Trix (`airtrix`, `airtrixo`)
- Brave Firefighters (`braveff`)
- Planet Harriers (`pharrier`)
- NASCAR Arcade (`sgnascar`, `sgnascaro`)
- Star Wars Racer Arcade (`swracer`)
- Cyber Troopers Virtual-On Force (`von4`)

They play with a keyboard, mice, gamepads, wheels with force feedback (NASCAR) or light guns (Brave Firefighters). Each game is a MAME ROM and needs the BIOS `hikaru.zip` and `mie.zip` too.

## Downloads

|---|---|
| odin-v0.1.0-windows-x86_64.zip | Windows 10 or 11 |
| odin-x86_64.AppImage / odin-v0.1.0-linux-x86_64.tar.gz | Linux PC with glibc 2.38 or later (e.g. Ubuntu 24.04) |

# YukiHub v0.4.5 更新日志

> 本次更新聚焦：**四平台游玩状态同步 · Hikarinagi 快捷登录优化 · SD 卡目录授权 · 稳定性修复**

## ✨ 全新功能

- **同步游玩状态至四个平台**：现在可以把本地的游玩时长与进度，一键同步到 **NextMoe·未萌（鲲 Galgame）**、**VNDB**、**Bangumi** 与 **Hikarinagi**。四个平台的入口统一收进个人资料页的「同步游玩状态」折叠卡，点开后按平台逐项操作，状态一目了然。
- **Hikarinagi 快捷登录支持邮箱识别**：现在用 Hikarinagi 快捷登录时会一并读取邮箱，若该邮箱已在 YukiHub 注册过，**将直接登录并绑定到原账号**，与 NextMoe·未萌 的行为完全一致，不再另开新号、云同步数据也不会分裂。

## 🎨 体验优化

- **内置 Gal 工具箱常规维护**：同步更新内置工具箱里的网址与内容，保持可用。
- **同步进度弹窗重做**：进度展示改为环形进度 + 分步状态，四个平台的同步过程都能清楚看到当前在做什么。
- **新增取消绑定游玩状态同步凭证**:打开对应窗口后，长按即可弹出取消，清空凭证以重新登陆。
- **bangumi游戏自定义查询新增id查询**:因api缺陷，部分游戏不能直接搜到，因此新增了id搜索，在自定义搜索界面，直接输入数字is即可。

## 🛠 问题修复

- **修复 NextMoe 源封面模糊的问题**：部分作品封面会取到低分辨率图，现已修正取图逻辑。
- **修复通知权限疯狂弹窗的问题**：此前会反复请求通知权限，现已正常。
- **修复 SD 卡授权时选不到指定文件夹的问题**：内置文件选择器新增 SD 卡支持，现在可以正常选中 SD 卡里的游戏目录。

## 📌 说明

- **同步范围**：VNDB 不支持通过 API 写入游玩时长，因此同步到 VNDB 时只同步状态。
- **首次同步需要授权**：各平台同步需先在对应平台完成一次授权，之后会在后台自动使用。
- **Hikarinagi 登录**：已用旧方式登录过的老账号不受影响，仍会登录原来的账号；新登录会自动识别邮箱。
- **升级不影响存档**：本次更新不涉及引擎与存档逻辑，原有存档数据可正常读取。

---

感谢每一位玩家的反馈与支持，祝游玩愉快！🎮

### The gamepad and the touch stick

The face buttons of a controller are one choice now: by position (the Switch's
layout - X on top, Y on the left, A on the right, B at the bottom) or by what
the controller prints. It is set per controller in the gamepad center and takes
effect at once. The per-key rebinding is gone: it needed a capture flow and a
binding table, players got lost in it, and a rebound button took another key's
source away without anyone seeing why. The center's scope shows what the game
receives, so pressing a button is the test.

The controller's axes are read the way that controller reports them. The Xbox
family (a USB xpad, a Bluetooth XInput pad) puts its triggers on Z/RZ and its
right stick on RX/RY - the opposite of the usual layout - so those pads'
triggers never fired and their right stick never reached the game. The app now
works the roles out of the device's own ranges.

The touch stick starts where the thumb lands: the offset is taken from the
point the finger went down, so a thumb on the rim has output right away. A
small dead zone around that point, the rim is the full deflection, and the
right stick is finer at low speed.

## Before you update · 更新之前(必读)

- (EN) This build fixes the runtime build on the phone. If you have not imported the profiles package of v0.4.0-alpha01 yet, you still must: the app runs the games on the new host (0.4.0), and the old package's packs were built for the previous one. Import it in the environment check (the "manage" box).
- (中文) 本版修复了手机上的运行库构建。如果你还没有导入 v0.4.0-alpha01 的档案包，现在仍然必须导入：App 用新宿主(0.4.0)运行游戏，旧档案包的数据包是按旧宿主构建的。到环境检查里(那个"管理"按钮)导入。

## Fixed: the runtime a game needs on the phone builds again

The new host (0.4.0) checks every profile's picture - the screenshot the README shows - and looked for it in the app's own tool folder, where the pictures are not shipped: the build failed with "readme_image 'docs/images/...': no such file in the repository", and every game whose profile names a picture could not be rebuilt. The check now runs where the pictures are (a checkout of the repository), and the app's own copy leaves it out. Sixty games had a picture in their profile: all of them build now.

The fix is in the app, so the runtime on the phone is rebuilt as soon as the app is updated. Nothing to import for this one.

---

## 中文说明

### 修复:游戏在手机上需要的运行库又能构建了

## Before you update · 更新之前(必读)

- (EN) This release moves the packs onto a new host (0.4.0). After the app updates, you **must** import the new profiles package in the environment check (the "manage" box): the old package's packs were built for the previous host and will not work with this app. The app will remind you and point you there. Update the app first, then import the package - both steps are required.
- (中文) 本次更新更换了数据包运行的宿主(0.4.0)。更新 App 之后，**必须**到环境检查里(那个"管理"按钮)导入新的档案包:旧档案包的数据包是按旧宿主构建的，和新版 App 不匹配，无法正常使用。App 会主动提醒并指路。先更新 App，再导入档案包，两步都不能少。

## New games: NieR:Automata, Link's Awakening, Silver Pines

Three games join the profiles package:

- **NieR:Automata The End of YoRHa Edition** - boots with update 1.0.3, and the map is drawn correctly after loading a save. Broader gameplay checks are still pending, so expect rough edges.
- **The Legend of Zelda: Link's Awakening** - playable on update 1.1.0, verified on a Lenovo TB323FU. It runs at a dynamic 30/60 fps by default; the stable-60 option stays off (it can judder on weaker chips). It needs the firmware files.
- **Silver Pines** - the v65536 update (1.0.1) plays, verified on the Xiaomi 23117RK66C (Android 16).

## Fixed: the failed ports

The separate profiles package had broken the ports: the patches of an
imported profile never reached the build, and the port failed - FINAL
FANTASY RESONANCE's allocator cut was missing, its Unreal allocator
reserved 38 GB of address space, and the port died. Fixed: the imported
profile reaches the rewriter now, in every port and every runtime
rebuild.

## New game: Catherine: Full Body

The Korean / Chinese v0 release of Catherine: Full Body is playable, at
a held 30 fps as on the Switch, verified on device. Import the profiles
package again after the update (the environment check's "manage" box),
or the game is not in your layer.

Also in the APK: a game that compiles its own shaders at boot can be
ported on the phone; anime intros no longer freeze and movies no longer
end on a black screen; the builds page says when your profiles package
is older than this build's.

---

## 中文说明

### 修复：移植失败

独立档案包导致移植失败：导入档案里的补丁没有进入构建（《最终幻想 共鸣》
缺了分配器裁剪，预留 38 GB 内存闪退）。已修复：导入的档案现在能正确送达
改写器，每次移植和运行库重建都会用到。

### 新游戏：凯瑟琳 Full Body

《凯瑟琳 Full Body》韩版/中文 v0 发售版可玩，稳定 30 帧（与 Switch 一致），
真机验证过。更新后请重新导入档案包（环境检查里的"管理"），否则手机上没有
这个游戏。

APK 里还有：开机自编着色器的游戏支持手机移植；动画开场不再定格、影片不再

## The app no longer carries the game profiles

The profiles are half a gigabyte of shader tables, and every release
copied them again. This build carries none of them. After the update,
import the profiles package once: Settings → the environment check, or the
profiles row's "manage" box, which can fetch this build's own package for
you (the download is digest-checked). The package is the release's second
file. It lives outside the app's own storage, so future updates never
touch it.

**Packs built with this version need this app to run** - the pack no
longer carries the runtime inside; the app keeps one runtime per game and
builds it when the game page opens. The games already on your phone keep
working.

### New
- The game page checks and rebuilds the game itself; a failure shows the
  reason with a retry. The "update runtime" chore is gone.
- Tapping a game resumes it or refuses it - no more wrongly greyed-out
  cards.
- Pin a game to the home screen from its detail panel; the shortcut opens
  through the launch gate and greys out when the game is deleted.
- A port can be exported as one folder and taken to another phone; the
  same game can be in the library twice.
